answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the raven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sonnet of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
